    Point–brick data without sincerity #

    PointBrick' is PointBrick without the condition that V is nonzero at every vertex other than x; its body at a fixed point and brick is PointBrickAt. It still gives a Kronecker pair whose extensions respect the cover, supported on the point and the support of the brick (pair_of_pointBrickAt, pair_of_pointBrick'), hence the support-free critical step (criticalPieceCarriesPair_of_pointBrickData).
